prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity compact PhotoStore native dark-gray desktop image editor design reference board, landscape. Two clearly separated close-up interface states, with heading 'PhotoStore · Small workflow fixes'. Left state titled 'Rename layers and groups': a familiar native Layers panel with small eye icons, folder called 'Backgrounds', child raster layer 'Sky study', inline name text field focused with blue text selection, subtle standard Cut / Copy / Paste context menu. Small caption 'Text clipboard stays in the focused name field'. Right state titled 'Brush diameter': compact existing-style gray brush options bar with Size field reading exactly '1 px', simple brush circle preview beneath, and understated keycap sequence '[  3 px → 2 px → 1 px'. Caption 'Decrease reaches 1 px and stops'. This is a behavioral reference for minimal fixes, preserve mature image-editor proportions, no new app redesign, no floating decorative cards, no marketing graphics. Use legible typography, thin dividers, restrained blue focus accents. No characters, people, illustrations, private artwork, or known character imagery. A small footer 'DESIGN REFERENCE · NOT A RUNNING APP CAPTURE'.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a precise high-fidelity desktop interface design concept for PhotoStore, an original Rust-native image editor with a clean professional video timeline combining Photoshop layer/Smart Object editing and CapCut editing clarity. Landscape 16:9 whole desktop app, crisp legible small typography and plausible native egui flat UI; charcoal neutral panels, thin separators, muted media-specific clip colors, restrained cyan selection. Header PhotoStore, File Edit Image Layer Select Filter View Window Help. Upper 55%: left narrow Media bin with three landscape-only media thumbnails named coast.mp4, cloud.png, music.wav and an Import button; large center 16:9 preview of an abstract coastal landscape with simple typographic title 'Coast study' (NO people, NO characters, NO existing artwork); small transport below preview reading 00:00:04:12 / 00:00:12:00, 30 fps, play controls. Right inspector width ~280px: tabs Clip / Audio; selected 'Title · Smart Object'; Transform group Position X/Y, Scale linked, Rotation; Opacity; small key diamonds and previous/next beside supported fields; Source/Edit Contents action; lower Layers tab shows corresponding group/Smart Object/image/video layers, selection synchronized. Timeline lower 45% entire width, NOT a stack of property forms. One compact horizontal icon toolbar Select Split Undo Redo Snap Link Keyframes plus timeline zoom slider right. One pinned time ruler 0s 2s 4s 6s 8s 10s 12s. Fixed 180px left gutter with track names and tiny eye/lock/mute controls. Four horizontal aligned lanes: 'Title / Smart' purple editable compound clip; 'Overlay / Image' blue still-image clip; 'Main / Video' teal multiple adjacent video clips with coastline filmstrip thumbnails and small linked-audio badge; 'Music / Audio' green sound clip with media-like waveform illustration. One continuous thin white vertical playhead at 4.4s crossing every lane, one work-area bar and marker on ruler. Clip bars have label, clear trim edges, understated selection outline; no repeated Video Clips or Layer tracks headings, no Enable stopwatch buttons, no giant sliders, no duplicate rulers. At very bottom a compact collapsed strip 'Keyframes · Title' with small diamond summary; key graphs not expanded by default. No repeated property values on timeline lanes. Small footer clearly says 'GPT IMAGE DESIGN CONCEPT · NOT IMPLEMENTATION EVIDENCE'. Match realistic editor density; no marketing poster, cards, gradients, 3D presentation, AI service buttons or fake performance numbers. This is an original proposed layout, not a screenshot or branded clone.
